item.description: ### Fixed - **Two copies of Perch no longer fight over your agents.** Starting a second one used to take the connection to your sessions away from the first, which kept running but stopped hearing anything — no error, no warning. A second copy now says so and quits. - **The menu bar list scrolls.** It had a limit of eight sessions before scrolling, which most people never reached, so the panel just kept growing. It's five now, and the scrollbar is visible so you can tell there's more. - **The lock screen says what just finished.** When your last agent stopped, the card spent its final seconds showing "no active sessions" instead of the work it had been following.
